plan.method: One independent root search and a fresh child search for every distinct candidate move, each with 300000 nodes. Both mapped to original root side-to-move. Root and child context differ by one ply; raw deltas retained, negative CPL clipped to zero and reported. Mates kept separate. No tablebases or assistance during matches.

method: SF root chooses reference move at 300k nodes. Every distinct candidate including that reference move is analyzed from its child at 300k nodes, fresh hash, one thread, Hash64, no TB, original root-side perspective. Child-vs-child score delta is primary; root-vs-child context is also retained. Negative raw losses indicate bounded-budget inconsistency, not negative error. Mates and terminal outcomes stay separate; probability transforms are descriptive, not calibrated win probabilities.
